title: Jesus... I Feel Like The Extra In Everyone Else's Story. 🎬
topic: she feels like the extra in everyone else's story, seated at every table but talked around instead of to

bible.text: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I feel like the extra in everyone else's story. 🎬

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone gets celebrated. I just get talked around.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You count who speaks first. I sing over you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: You love everyone. I can't picture You delighted with me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I rejoice over you with joy and singing. Still singing.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not the extra. You're the one the song is about.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone who feels invisible tonight. 🎶
